content.what_it_is: Positional input file for the Fortran filtering tool. It names test.txt as input, supplies the dimensions 301 by 201, supplies a filter setting of 3 with a note that 3 or 5 are accepted and that 3-point corresponds to a seven-point window in each direction, and names filtered.txt as output.
entities: filter setting and inline explanation — line 3

verbatim_spans.text: 3  ---3 or 5, e.g. 3point (7 points window) in each direction

unresolved: The positional file does not name the two dimensions or state their ordering (line 2).
The line-3 wording does not formally define how the setting 3 maps to a seven-point window or how setting 5 maps to a window size.
